rubrics.justification: Accurately identifies a very poor-quality Day 5 blastocyst consistent with 1DD, noting absent/degenerate ICM and TE and possible collapse; minor limitation is some speculative detail (dark irregular outer cells, lack of zona-specific comment).
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, tubal factor, semen quality, endometrium, BMI/lifestyle, and first-cycle status with embryo morphology and prognosis.
Reasoning is logical and internally consistent, with prognosis tied to age and severe morphology; only minor issue is somewhat broad probability framing and a few speculative caveats.

Generally aligned with Gardner grading and standard IVF practice, including SET, hydrosalpinx consideration, and selective PGT-A discussion; slight overreach in suggesting FET preference without stronger case-specific indication.

Provides clear practical recommendations for current transfer and future planning, including hydrosalpinx evaluation, counseling, uterine assessment, and when to consider PGT-A or sperm DNA fragmentation testing.
